spells/whirlwind-of-teeth-190.name: Whirlwind of Teeth
spells/whirlwind-of-teeth-190.effectSummary: Creates an opaque cylinder of swirling, roaring mouths and teeth. Creatures in the area take 1d8 damage for every two caster levels, to a maximum of 10d8, with a Reflex save for half and spell resistance applying. You can mentally direct the whirlwind as a free action, moving it at a speed of 40 feet. Its area is a cylinder with a 5-foot radius per caster level and a height of 10 feet per caster level, and it lasts 1 round per caster level. The arcane material component is a handful of bloody teeth.

provenance.role: Book of Vile Darkness primary effect and header reviewed; opacity, cylinder dimensions, scaling damage and cap, save/SR, free-action mental movement, speed, duration and material component preserved
